answer: Dilini is 21, daughter of Nimal and Kumari. She’s been accepted to the Colombo Medical Faculty (this is established in E1) and will leave the village for medical school in episode 2. In the canon she wears a saree and appears in the tea-shop scenes with Sahan (E1S2, E2S2 open scene, and later E3 scenes). In this open scene she’s packing her anatomy textbooks into a cloth bag (b0), speaks three short lines here (L2, L4, L6), and ends looking at Sahan in silence (b7). Her character beats: eager/committed to study, but anxious about leaving (she says she’s afraid), and family ties to Nimal and Kumari are important to her story.
